name: Flood & Crop Watch
objective: Image flood-prone land and crops and deliver at least 0.5 GB of imagery per day, revisiting each area within 3 days, for at least 2 years.
source: budget, mass limit, revisit, lifetime: data brief; base mass 1.0 kg (6U structure, ANDES 6U platform: https://cta.ing.unlp.edu.ar/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/CUBESAT-6U-v5.pdf); base cost, ops cost, min data: estimate or game value

name: Radar Ocean & Ice Mapper
objective: Map sea ice and ocean surfaces with an X-band radar from orbit, delivering at least 15 GB of data per day with a revisit within 7 days, for at least 3 years.
source: mass limit 150 kg set above the 85 to 110 kg ICEYE class (https://sar.iceye.com/5.0/productguide/fleet); budget, base values, revisit, data, lifetime: game value / estimate

name: Lunar Mapper
objective: Map the Moon from a 50 km polar orbit for at least 1 year and return at least 20 GB of data per day.
source: mass limit 2,000 kg: data brief; budget scaled from LRO's cost of roughly $460 million (https://webarchive.library.unt.edu/eot2008/20080916013832/http://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/database/MasterCatalog?sc=LUNARRO); base values, data: estimate; lifetime 1 year: LRO primary mission
